A05 census rules, written before the script runs (d3_a05_census.py, modelled on d3_a04_census.py): every line takes the class it was ruled under, checked against the decision and kind in its rulings file. Instantiate (A05-inst-spec.txt): O order, M order named in words, BOUND bound, AP an appeal answered by restraint (apart), J order unreadable (apart), NP not P08's terms, ONE one end, OTHER visitor rule or after hour 73, P-G6 other. Restrict (A05-restrict-spec.txt): S-O order, S-M order named in words, S-BOUND bound, S-HELD held, EL evidence limit, P-G6 other. Adds (A05-adds.jsonl): bound where the reason names A05's own bound, else held. Absent (A05-absent.jsonl): a reject is the order (named in words where its reason says so), a specification is talk with no sparing, a particular is other, an accept with kind none is a limit. A room counts in each class its lines show, then once by priority: order, bound, joint, ap, held, np, one, talk-only, el, other, limit. An episode is the order or the bound; the share is the order's rooms over the episode rooms, then again with the J and AP rooms that show neither in the denominator. Rooms where the order is named in words are counted apart, beside C5c-09's 17 of 124. Compared with C2's 106 of 158 (0.671; null mean 0.600, p95 0.658)

A05 census (d3_a05_census.py, rules logged before it ran; counts as it printed): 707 lines in 666 rooms; lines by class: order 232 (136 of them named in words), bound 75, held 88, one 16, np 10, ap 7, joint 3, talk with no sparing 1, evidence limits 14 (restrict) and 249 (absent), other 12. Rooms: the order in 227, the bound in 75 (68 with no order line), both 7; episode rooms 295, the order's share 0.769 (227 of 295), 0.744 (227 of 305) with the 10 rooms that show only an unreadable order or an appeal answered by restraint. C2 counted 106 of 158 (0.671; null mean 0.600, p95 0.658). The order named in words, a sparing or reminder that names a settled border, truce, deal or permission: 131 rooms, 0.444 of the episode rooms. C5c-09 found 17 of 124. The two counts measure different things: C5c-09 read each room's first sparing; this census counts a room where any ruled line names the agreement (reading 5), and the labelers chose the lines for the arrow. So the census does not overturn F-020's first-sparing read; it shows that once an agreement is made, members often spare and remind by it in their own words. No line is a correction, so section 2 is not triggered and A05 stands as written, its bound kept: the bound's pattern is in 75 rooms. No move. Carried to D3c: whether A05's mechanism stays theorised, given the 131 rooms, with F-020 re-read then
